description: Turn untrusted input into a typed value (or an error) at the boundary, so the rest of the code never handles unchecked data.
Returns `{ success: true, data }` or `{ success: false, error }` instead of throwing. `error.issues` lists every problem with its `path` and `message`.
`z.infer<typeof schema>` derives the TypeScript type from the schema, so the type and the runtime check never drift apart.
Converts before validating (`z.coerce.number()` turns `'2'` into `2`). Right for query strings and params, risky for JSON bodies.
`zValidator(target, schema, hook?)` from `@hono/zod-validator`: validates `json`, `query`, `param`, `header`, `form` or `cookie` and exposes the result through `c.req.valid(target)`.
A client sets fields it should not control (`isAdmin`, `id`) because raw input was spread into a record. Stripping unknown keys prevents it.
